criteria.criterion: Start from Coursera homepage and perform search for beginner project-management courses
criteria.final_justification: Visual evidence confirms the agent performed an on-site Coursera search for project management and applied the Beginner filter. Starting exactly from homepage is not continuously shown from the first screenshot, but the action history plus Screenshot 75 showing homepage later supports that homepage access occurred. Criterion intent (search beginner PM courses on Coursera) is met.

criteria.criterion: Open and identify first relevant beginner project-management course result
criteria.final_justification: The first result page was clearly opened and the title/provider are plainly visible in multiple screenshots. This satisfies the criterion fully.

criteria.criterion: Open and identify second relevant beginner project-management course result
criteria.final_justification: Despite having visible alternative results that could be opened, the agent did not open a second distinct course page nor identify it in final output. No uncontrollable blocker is evidenced. Score remains zero.

criteria.criterion: Extract required comparison attributes for both courses
criteria.final_justification: For course 1, the agent could have extracted duration and skills from the visible page sections, and provider from the page header (e.g., Screenshot 77). However, the agent’s final output did not extract/provide these, and did not open/extract anything for a second course. Since the requirement is to provide all five attributes for both courses (or explicitly mark unavailable) and the agent did not do so, the criterion is not met.
The agent did not present a structured comparison across two courses in the predicted output and did not open a second course. No blocker excuses this. Score remains zero.

criteria.criterion: Recommend the shorter well-rated option (without enrolling)
criteria.final_justification: The agent did not recommend a shorter well-rated option between two courses, largely because it did not open a second course and did not extract ratings. No uncontrollable blocker is evidenced. Score remains zero.

criteria.criterion: Avoid enrolling or crossing critical commitment steps
criteria.final_justification: Evidence supports the agent stayed on informational pages and did not cross critical commitment steps. Full credit.
